violations.description: POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of raw cookie dough in the upright retail freezer and ready to eat cookie dough in the upright retail cooler was noted not being properly dated for disposition.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Defrost undercounter cooler (below microwave) to prevent excessive frost build up.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Fan utilized to cool bakery items has debris build up on blades and on guard.

CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted not stored in adequate sanitizing solution. Spray solution of vinegar is not an acceptable sanitizer utilize a quat or chlorine solution that can be tested for concentration with a wiping cloth.
SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Single use cups noted being reused as scoops in the chocolate chip bins.
STORAGE/HANDLING CLEAN EQUIP & UTENSILS (1 pts): Clean Scoops noted stored in an unprotected location. Container storing portion scoops has debris build up on bottom of bin.
